name: Figma
summary: Collaborative browser-based design canvas for UI, prototyping, whiteboarding, slides and developer handoff, with AI agent features.
description: The canvas where design, code and AI come together: Figma Design, Dev Mode, FigJam whiteboards, Slides, Draw, Motion, Sites and AI workflows (Figma agent, Figma Make) share one workspace with real-time collaboration. Includes a free Starter plan, a font library of 1,648 fonts, 300+ team templates and the Figma community with 1,000+ more.
